files.title.txt: Buy now, pay later just got grown-up rules (UK)
files.description.txt:
Since 15 July 2026, many buy now, pay later (BNPL) deals in the UK are regulated by the FCA. Before lending, the provider has to check you can afford it. You get clear details up front, including when payments are due and what happens if you miss one. If you're struggling, they have to help, and if something goes wrong, you can complain to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

Not covered: deals taken out before 15 July 2026, and deals where the shop itself lends to you. So check the date, and check the lender on the FCA Firm Checker.

Sources:
FCA, "New protections confirmed for Buy Now Pay Later borrowers" (press release, 11 February 2026): https://www.fca.org.uk/news/press-releases/new-protections-confirmed-buy-now-pay-later-borrowers
FCA, "Buy now pay later" (consumer guidance, updated 6 August 2026): https://www.fca.org.uk/consumers/buy-now-pay-later

General information, not personal financial advice.
